globalRules: Keep source node IDs39, original questions/givens/definitions/case boundaries. Changed interactions receive newr7 IDs.

Global source order remains; each step requires the preceding mathematical fact. Intra-parent row prerequisites are explicit: no later completed row or final answer before prior part success.
A shared coefficient entered once mirrors into both products; repeated display is not another independently graded decision.
Wrong draft remains editable. No canonical correct row replaces wrong draft. No downstream note, prior-results entry or tooltip reveals unfinished answers.
Equality chains are for equal expressions; condition/sign case selection is separate prose or implication, never connected by equality.
Solved unaryplus is omitted in canonical output. Negative operands are bracketed.
